The '''Army of the First Line''' was an organization that was active around the time of the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
[[Vlaydm Churhee]] served as a [[Sniper/Legends|sharpshooter]] in the Army of the First Line on [[Ulda Frav]]. In the [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] following the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Vlaydm Churhee used this experience to form a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] unit named after him: [[Churhee's Riflemen]].<ref name="GAW" />
